name: unslop
description: Post-generation engineering quality. Codesavers removes avoidable complexity from changed code; Specsavers authors and reviews technical software specifications for precision, information density, and decision completeness.

interface.shortDescription: Tighten generated code and technical specifications.
interface.longDescription: Use Codesavers to remove avoidable complexity from changed code and Specsavers to author or review precise, concise, implementation-ready technical specifications.
defaultPrompt: Unslop this implementation and report concrete simplifications.
Use Codesavers to review my current changes for avoidable complexity.
Specsavers this technical design before I send it for review.
Use Specsavers to write an implementation-ready spec for this feature.
Does this design actually warrant an ADR?
